_comment: Each entry is a dialogue tree keyed by an id. 'default' trees are used when no more specific/conditional tree applies for that character. Nodes reference each other by id within the tree. A choice can carry relationshipDelta (applied to the NPC the player is talking to), setFlag, and next (the next node id, or null to end the conversation).

hello.text: Oh, hey. Didn't expect to see you over here.

bake_offer.text: Hey! Want to see what I baked today?

choices.text: Did you make something for someone?

bake_show.text: It's a matcha roll! Still warm, too. Here, try a piece.

bake_deflect.text: Huh? Oh — no, no one in particular. Just practicing.

critique.text: If you're going to stand in my kitchen, at least look like you know what a knife is for.

choices.text: You could be nicer about it.

theory.text: You felt that too, right? The temperature drop by the old shrine gate. There's a pattern to it.
